response.sql: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) as num_orders FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender), gender_stats AS (SELECT gender, SUM(num_orders) as total_orders_for_gender, COUNT(*) as customer_count FROM customer_orders WHERE gender IS NOT NULL GROUP BY gender), customer_shares AS (SELECT co.customer_id, co.gender, co.num_orders, co.num_orders * 1.0 / NULLIF(gs.total_orders_for_gender, 0) as share, 1.0 / gs.customer_count as avg_share_for_gender FROM customer_orders co JOIN gender_stats gs ON co.gender = gs.gender) SELECT customer_id, gender, num_orders, share, share - avg_share_for_gender as gap_above_average FROM customer_shares WHERE share > avg_share_for_gender ORDER BY gap_above_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
